title.zh: 序列到序列与注意力机制

en.a: Replace a single fixed-length recurrent bottleneck with a differentiable, row-normalized read from all encoder states.
en.b: Derive the encoder-state gradient through softmax alignment and distinguish attention path length from attention arithmetic cost.

zh.a: 用一个可微的、行归一化的读取操作替代单个固定长度的循环瓶颈，该操作从所有编码器状态中读取。
zh.b: 通过 softmax 对齐推导编码器状态的梯度，并区分注意力路径长度与注意力算术成本。
